text:
Mae Li: quick ask — can someone run a lightweight onboarding bench for glasswing-6b (fp16, q4f16) on a p4d-ish node? Need smoke + tail latency (p50/p95/p99) for seq=128 and seq=512, batch sizes 1,4,8. KV-warmup profile would be great. No full throughput sweep, just enough to decide next steps :pray:

Samir K: I can run this in ~30m. Which model tag should I use? latest or the v1-onboard artifact?

Mae Li: use model-registry tag glasswing-6b:v1-onboard. Pin to prod kernels and enable kv_cache_warmup=true. Thanks.

Samir K: ok kicking off now. command I'm using:
```
./bench/run_onboard.sh \n  --model glasswing-6b:v1-onboard \n  --dtype fp16 --quant q4f16 \n  --seq-lens 128,512 --batches 1,4,8 \n  --kv-warmup true \n  --node-type p4d.24xlarge \n  --profiling flame,smem \
```
Starting as job 8742. I'll post quick numbers when done.

CI Bot: Job 8742 queued -> started (runner: p4d-14). Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/8742/logs

Evan G: smoke results from job 8742 (raw, minimal filtering):
- seq=128 bs=1: p50=46ms, p95=118ms, p99=235ms
- seq=128 bs=4: p50=78ms, p95=210ms, p99=460ms
- seq=128 bs=8: p50=130ms, p95=345ms, p99=760ms
- seq=512 bs=1: p50=162ms, p95=420ms, p99=910ms
Throughput rough: seq128 bs8 ~18 tok/s (on that node). KV-warmup reduced cold p99 by ~15% vs no-warmup.

Evan G: quick compare vs our 7b baseline (gryphon-7b-light): p95 is ~+10-18% slower for glasswing-6b on same hw (expected given config). No obvious OOMs.

Priya S: thanks for numbers. Can you attach the perf flame and smem snapshots? want to check kernel stalls and cuda memcpy patterns. Also did you see any misc kernel fallbacks in logs?

Samir K: attaching artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/glasswing/8742/perf_flame.svg and https://artifacts.redwood/glasswing/8742/smem.txt
No kernel fallbacks in the runner logs; one small nvlink retry at t=00:02:14 but recovered.

ops-bot: Perf snapshot created -> https://console.redwood/perf/snapshots/8742 (includes timeline + KV warmup trace)

Priya S: scanning flame: a lot of time in rotary_pos_emb kernel and attention softmax for seq512 — maybe tune tiling or try reordering matmul kernel selection. Also the memcpy spikes line up with p99s.

Mae Li: next steps — 1) Evan/Priya to file a short perf ticket with recommended kernel/tile knobs; 2) Samir to run a single A/B with altered tiling (if easy) else schedule deeper profiling; 3) keep this model in canary but not full rollout yet.

Evan G: opening infra ticket INF-3421: "glasswing-6b: p95 regression & tiling investigation" with links to artifacts and perf snapshot. Assigning to eng-runtime.

Samir K: noted. If nobody objects I'll try bs=4 seq=128 with alternate kernels tomorrow morning and post results.

Mae Li: perfect, thanks everyone :rocket: 

CI Bot: Job 8742 completed (exit 0). Artifacts uploaded.

Evan G: final note — quality eval on the same artifact looks comparable to baseline (sanity pass), so perf work is the main blocker for rollout.

Priya S: will triage INF-3421 and propose a short experiment plan by EOD tomorrow.

Mae Li: great — marking this thread resolved for now. Ping if anything blocks.
